lessons.rule: Never include apostrophes or unescaped colons in ASS/drawtext file paths passed to FFmpeg filtergraphs; always use neutral filenames like subs_clip_01.ass inside /tmp/clip_work/.
Never upload isolated unedited GTA 6 cutscenes, ending spoilers, or pre-launch leaked footage; require transformative hook banner, word-by-word captions, or reaction framing.
Keep punch-in gap >= 18.0s and max zoom <= 1.06x on vertical crops; more frequent zooms (>3/min) read as visual twitching and hurt retention.

lessons.source: Live Google AI Studio key verification (2026-11-21)
lessons.rule: gemini-2.5-flash returns 404 for new keys and gemini-3.8-flash can 503/timeout under load; default to gemini-3.1-flash-lite with automatic fallback to gemini-3.5-flash-lite and deterministic heuristic scorer.

lessons.source: Live slice extraction diagnosis on MRlz84PjaAc (2026-11-21)
lessons.rule: Install yt-dlp-ejs with --js-runtimes node and prefer protocol^=m3u8 formats when running --download-sections so yt-dlp fetches exact HLS segments without ffmpeg receiving 403 Forbidden on raw HTTPS URLs.

lessons.source: Live IPv4 vs IPv6 HLS test on MRlz84PjaAc (2026-11-21)
lessons.rule: Force IPv4 (-4) with youtube:player_client=visionos on m3u8 --download-sections first to bypass IPv6 googlevideo.com 403s and GVS PO-token requirements.
When calling httpx.post(..., files=...), pass a dict with list values for repeated keys like {'platform[]': ['youtube']} rather than a list of tuples.
